Data policy: no fabricated proxies. Official public sources provide the primary foundation for Precious Metals; native statistical and central bank releases are prioritized where available. 数据原则：不制造 proxy。官方公开来源提供贵金属的基础数据；优先接入本国统计局与央行的原生发布序列。
